description: This file defines a BroadcastReceiver class 'MyReceiver' that handles specific broadcast intents to refresh shortcuts and show a toast message upon pin request acceptance.

classes.name: MyReceiver
classes.description: A BroadcastReceiver that listens for locale change and custom pin request acceptance intents, handling UI refresh and user notifications.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Handles broadcast intents for locale changes and pin request acceptance, triggering shortcut refresh and toast notifications.

methods.name: getPinRequestAcceptedIntent
methods.description: Creates and returns a PendingIntent that triggers the 'ACTION_PIN_REQUEST_ACCEPTED' broadcast when activated.
